entities.name: Roy R. Rubottom, Jr.
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Roy Richard Rubottom Jr. was an American diplomat, most notable for being Assistant Secretary of State for Inter-American Affairs from 1957 to 1960, a post in which he played a major role in engineering the United States' response to the Cuban Revolution.
